messages:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up we still need to pick a pattern for cohort recoding + cost provenance for sampled traces. Prefer a short async thread, avoid a big sync.
kai: Two options: (A) recode at gateway/edge so billing keys exist early; (B) recode in ingest/enrichment so we dont touch SDKs. Tradeoffs below.
anika: Gateway recode sketch: compact header so agents add minimal bytes.

```
X-RD-PROV: t=acme;c=smp-v2;o=orig:acme:2024-09
```

That gives an immediate billing key and an "orig" provenance token for audits.
jordan: Concern: cohort variants in group-bys can explode cardinality. Need a normalization layer or mapping table to keep BQ/SQL queries stable.
lee: Also think about backfills. If key semantics change, older events need a mapping or queries will miss results. We should plan a lightweight mapping fallback.
sami: From finance/chargeback POV we prefer gateway recode + provenance. Keeps billing accurate for reserved capacity.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout proposal: gateway flag -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. At each step run 99p latency checks.
kai: Gateway recode pros: early attribution, simpler downstream joins. Cons: SDK/agent changes, slightly bigger envelopes. Ingest recode pros: fewer touchpoints, easier flags; cons: attribution lag and complicated late-sampled traces.
anika: Proposal: keep both compact key and provenance blob. Example ingest field: trace.meta.prov = "o=acme;c=smp-v2;r=gw|ingest;t=1700000000" encoded as compact ASCII.
jordan: For queries add cohort_normalize(cohort) helper and a small mapping table we maintain during rollout. That prevents ad-hoc queries from exploding.
maya: Tentative consensus: gateway recode + provenance retention + a normalization mapping. Action items:
- anika: draft short RFC with header proto, wire encoding, sample sizes (owner)
- kai: add SQL helper + doc snippet for cohort_normalize
- lee: own rollout feature flags + perf/SLO checklist
- jordan: run cardinality/cost estimate for worst-case cohorts
- sami: add perf gating tests comparing header path

anika: I'll post RFC link here when ready. Quick header example for RFC:

```
# header (compact ASCII)
X-RD-PROV: o=acme|c=smp-v2|r=gw-recode|t=1700000000
# ingest -> trace.meta.prov = "o=acme|c=smp-v2|r=gw-recode|t=1700000000"
```

lee: Start rollout on non-billing tenants + internal teams, validate perf, then expand.
jordan: I'll prototype cohort_normalize in SQL and share sample queries.
sami: I'll run microbenchmarks hitting gateway with/without header and post numbers.
maya: Thanks all. If RFC looks good we'll only do a 15-min sync if unresolved. :thumbsup:
